description: The pinned FHIR release, profile set, code systems, unit systems and element scope for the FHIR-to-SULO pilot. Everything SourceContext and MapContract need about the source side. Machine-readable; see profiles/README.md for prose.

release.note: R5 is a separate compatibility track (plan section 1). Element names such as effective[x] and occurrence[x] differ by release, so the renderer refuses any resource whose declared release is not 4.0.1.

source_server.note: Synthetic base used to form canonical resource IRIs and fhir:link targets. No such server is contacted; the pilot never performs network I/O at ingestion time.

renderer.canonical_form: N-Triples, UTF-8, LF line endings, lines sorted bytewise ascending, blank node labels assigned b0..bN by a depth-first walk in FHIR element order

option_notes.emit_code_system_class_assertions: The HL7 publisher adds 'a loinc:33914-3' / 'a sct:702668005' type arcs beside a Coding. That is a terminology-derived OWL class assertion, and concept note section 2 states that a FHIR code literal alone is not an OWL class assertion. Default off. Turned on only by the oracle-conformance test that reproduces HL7's own published Turtle byte-equivalently.
option_notes.emit_ontology_header: The '<...ttl> a owl:Ontology; owl:versionIRI <http://build.fhir.org/...>' block is an artifact of the HL7 publisher and points at build.fhir.org. Default off; on for the oracle test.
option_notes.emit_reference_stub_types: '<https://fhir.example/Patient/p123> a fhir:Patient .' Matches HL7 rendering and gives the source ShEx shape a typed node to match. This is a record-layer type, not a person claim.

pinned_profiles.note: The only profile the pilot asserts conformance to at Gate 0.
Blocked on reviewer question Q-A2-1. Claiming it forces Observation.category=vital-signs and a panel code on the BP fixtures, neither of which concept note section 5 specifies.
Blocked on reviewer question Q-A2-1. Would additionally require code 85354-9 on the panel and forbid Observation.value[x] on the parent.

Observation.source_only_note: Rendered into FHIR RDF and retained in the source layer, but not bound to a pivot variable. Observation.issued and Observation.meta.lastUpdated are deliberately NOT interchangeable with effective[x] (concept note section 2).

http://loinc.org.name: LOINC
http://loinc.org.version_policy: unversioned in the pilot; Observation.code.coding.version is retained verbatim if present

pinned_codes.display: Glomerular filtration rate/1.73 sq M.predicted [Volume Rate/Area] in Serum or Plasma by Creatinine-based formula (MDRD)

http://unitsofmeasure.org.name: UCUM

pinned_codes.note: Quantity.unit is human display text and is source-only. Quantity.code is the normalized unit binding (concept note section 4).

http://unitsofmeasure.org.note: Concept note section 4: missing or unrecognised UCUM units fail the numeric target shape. Recognition is against this pinned list only; Agent 5 owns any broader UCUM resolver.

notes: entered-in-error is source-only, never rejected: concept note section 2 says it suppresses clinical assertions but does not erase the source record.

Encounter in-progress is source-only pending an explicit policy (concept note section 6: 'may receive a separate, explicitly defined policy; it is not treated as a finished interval'). See reviewer question Q-A2-2.

valueQuantity.comparator_present.reason: Concept note section 4: a comparator requires a qualified-value mapping that does not exist at Gate 2. Never drop it while claiming an unqualified numeric result (section 2).

dataAbsentReason_present.reason: Concept note section 4: dataAbsentReason produces no numeric hasValue.

code_not_in_pinned_set.reason: Concept note section 2: a code-to-class interpretation needs a reviewed terminology rule.

unresolvable_reference.reason: Concept note section 4: an unresolved or ambiguous reference cannot be silently treated as a person IRI.

ambiguous_reference.reason: Acceptance matrix row Identity: ambiguous identity never silently merges.

unsupported_modifier_extension.reason: Acceptance matrix row Source fidelity: an unsupported modifier extension blocks semantic materialization. SourceContext enforces this.

temporal_precision_policy.rule: The xsd datatype of a rendered date/dateTime/instant literal is chosen from the lexical form so that precision survives the rendering.
temporal_precision_policy.unknown_endpoint: An absent Period.end is rendered as an absent triple, never as an invented value. The 'open-ended period' fixture asserts this.

terminology_snapshot: pilot-pinned/0.1.0 (this manifest; no external terminology server is contacted)
